hero.title: Trillo - Modern Flexbox Hotel Booking UI
hero.tagline: Advanced CSS Flexbox layouts for beautiful, responsive booking interfaces

sections.title: Technical Approach
sections.content: Built entirely with Flexbox layouts, CSS custom properties, and SVG sprites. The architecture focuses on component-based design with BEM methodology, creating reusable patterns that scale across the application.

subsections.title: Flexbox Architecture
subsections.content: Implemented nested flex containers for complex layouts, using flex properties for responsive behavior without media queries where possible.

subsections.title: CSS Variables System
subsections.content: Established a comprehensive theming system using CSS custom properties for colors, spacing, and transitions.

sections.title: Implementation Details
sections.content: The application features a complete booking interface including header navigation, sidebar menu, hotel gallery, detailed information sections, user reviews, and call-to-action components. All interactions use CSS hover states and transitions.

sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: Delivered a pixel-perfect, responsive booking interface that demonstrates the power of modern CSS. The project serves as a reference implementation for Flexbox layouts and proves that complex UIs can be built without JavaScript.

sections.title: Design Excellence
sections.summary: Pixel-perfect hotel booking interface with smooth CSS transitions and hover states. Demonstrates advanced CSS capabilities for building modern web applications.

activity.author: CSS Enthusiast
activity.comment: This proves that complex UIs don't require JavaScript. The Flexbox patterns here are clean, maintainable, and perform excellently.

activity.author: Zachariah Ayers
activity.comment: Trillo showcases pure CSS Flexbox capabilities. Built a complete hotel booking UI with zero JavaScript - all interactions handled with CSS transitions and hover states.

businessRequirements.businessContext: Demonstrate advanced CSS capabilities for building modern web applications without JavaScript dependencies.
businessRequirements.problemStatement: Many developers rely heavily on JavaScript for layouts and interactions that can be achieved with modern CSS, adding unnecessary complexity and performance overhead.
businessValue: Faster page loads without JavaScript overhead
acceptanceCriteria: Complete hotel booking UI without JavaScript
